quote.text: What is death? Either a transition or an end. I am not afraid of coming to an end, this being the same as never having begun, nor of transition, for I shall never be in confinement quite so cramped anywhere else as I am here.
quote.author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Embrace the natural life transitions of both your children and yourself; just as Seneca suggests, every beginning and end offers a chance for growth and renewed purpose.
    • Teach your children that change is not confinement but a necessary passage that broadens their capacity for resilience and wisdom.
  • Leadership:
    • Recognize that transitions in any organization are opportunities for transformation rather than limitations, allowing you to guide your people through both endings and new beginnings.
    • Adopt a perspective where the fear of an end is replaced with the anticipation of a necessary evolution, empowering you to lead with confidence and clarity.
  • Product Management:
    • View each iteration or pivot in your product’s journey as a transition that liberates you from outdated constraints and paves the way for innovation.
    • Understand that fear of ending a product feature or approach can hinder progress; instead, embrace change as the catalyst for implementing improvements and discovering untapped potential.
